themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and interact with systems to achieve research objectives.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that help developers write, debug, refactor, and analyze code, enhancing productivity and efficiency in software development.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Explores how AI is being used to enhance product development workflows, from idea generation and market analysis to feature prioritization and user feedback processing.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Concerns AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, audio, or video into concise summaries, aiding in quick comprehension and insight extraction.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Investigates how AI is applied to recruitment processes, including talent sourcing, candidate screening, and analyzing the impact of AI on employment and workforce dynamics.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Highlights AI applications directly supporting design workflows, such as generating design assets, ideation, and streamlining the creative process.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Focuses on comparing, benchmarking, and reviewing various AI tools and platforms for their effectiveness, features, and suitability for specific tasks.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Examines the use of AI-generated or simulated users for testing, research, and design validation, exploring their benefits and limitations.

themes.name: AI coding assistants researchers
themes.description: Specifically looks at how researchers are studying and developing AI coding assistants, including their security implications and impact on software engineering practices.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Covers research and analysis of AI chatbots, including their capabilities, limitations, user interactions, and potential harms or benefits.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
